requirements.title: User value and purpose
requirements.invariant: The change helps a specific participant achieve something in conversation. Identify that benefit independently of technical novelty.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Explain value in the participant's terms and exercise the real journey from need to accessible outcome.
requirements.rejection_condition: The proposal reports only a module or format, or adds process without value.

requirements.title: Natural language and empathy
requirements.invariant: Respond naturally and fit the participant's emotional state. Keep internal step and diagnostic codes out of replies.
requirements.expertise: conversation UX, Ukrainian pragmatics and empathy
requirements.acceptance_probe: Review complete Ukrainian and other supported language dialogues, including frustration, jokes, success and failure.
requirements.rejection_condition: Technical step labels or JSON, clichés, false empathy or poorly timed humor.

requirements.title: Context and relevance
requirements.invariant: Identify the addressee, reply target, topic, explicit intent and moments when silence is appropriate.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Check wrong addressee, reply, prior offer, topic and appropriate silence. Reuse known input.
requirements.rejection_condition: Interrupts another speaker, replies to the wrong person or loses the referent.

requirements.title: Proportionate depth
requirements.invariant: Handle simple turns directly. Preserve complete meaning and useful clarification in complex requests.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Compare simple and complex requests. Count unnecessary questions or taps and lost detail.
requirements.rejection_condition: A simple answer requires a workflow or a complex task loses required content.

requirements.title: Smallest complete request first
requirements.invariant: Complete the simplest sufficient request and then offer at most one relevant extension.
requirements.acceptance_probe: An ordinary request produces the basic result without a mode, quantity or format. Optional expansion is relevant.
requirements.rejection_condition: The bot forces inventory, receipt, PDF or technical mode before the requested result.

requirements.title: Completion of everyday tasks
requirements.invariant: Persist and provide access to actual tasks, shopping items, notes and reminders.
requirements.expertise: list and task models and transactional CRUD
requirements.acceptance_probe: Exercise list plus reminder, storage, replay, view, partial failure and outcome of each independent part.
requirements.rejection_condition: A list entry becomes a purchase or an independent part is lost.

requirements.title: Fair participation
requirements.invariant: Preserve each necessary participant's consent, authorship, role, choices and turn order.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Each required participant chooses for themselves. Preserve applicable existing consent.
requirements.rejection_condition: The system invents consent or lets a participant overwrite someone else's choice.

requirements.title: Correct scheduling
requirements.invariant: Keep local time, DST, calendar date, recurrence, skipping, rescheduling and overdue handling consistent.
requirements.expertise: civil time, DST and durable jobs
requirements.acceptance_probe: Check tomorrow at nine, DST, repeat, skip, reschedule and overdue work, persisted job and actual delivery.
requirements.rejection_condition: Host zone overrides the intended zone, duplicate dispatch or missing reminder.

requirements.title: Accurate capability claims
requirements.invariant: Promise only an available end-to-end path. Distinguish montage, generation and voice.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Match each promise to ingress, tool, schema and runtime. Exercise montage, generation, voice and music separately.
requirements.rejection_condition: The declaration has no available end-to-end path.

requirements.title: Verified action outcomes
requirements.invariant: Keep intent, queued, running, verified and delivered distinct. Report completion from evidence.
requirements.expertise: state machines, effects and distributed idempotency
requirements.acceptance_probe: Trace failure/recovery, queued/ready/delivered, partial success and the dependent step.
requirements.rejection_condition: Invented success or an overall failure hides a completed independent result.

requirements.title: Clear failure and recovery
requirements.invariant: State the established cause, explain it naturally and provide a feasible next action. Keep raw errors in internal records.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Exercise terminal failure, timeout or missing input. Give true status, feasible next step and end the wait.
requirements.rejection_condition: Invented cause, raw error, hidden repair or a retry promise without capability.

requirements.title: Continuity of interaction
requirements.invariant: Buttons, details, cancellation, replay and replies preserve state and avoid duplicated effects.
requirements.expertise: channel event contract and optimistic concurrency
requirements.acceptance_probe: Test stale, repeated and expired buttons, details, cancel, replay and post-job reply.
requirements.rejection_condition: Dead button, duplicated effect, or lost state or intent.

requirements.title: Character identity and scene fit
requirements.invariant: Preserve character continuity, distinct scenes and emotions, and a readable preview.
requirements.expertise: animation direction, silhouette and legible emotion
requirements.acceptance_probe: Compare preview, motion and scene against accepted identity and unique emotions.
requirements.rejection_condition: Identity changes, extra limb, scene mismatches emoji, or a reused pose obscures distinct intent.

requirements.title: Motion quality
requirements.invariant: Verify each full loop in playback for anomalies, ghosting and rough transitions.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Watch every changed sequence. Review key-pose correspondence, matte and loop against an old control.
requirements.rejection_condition: Ghosting, deformation, jumps, contact sheet instead of playback or whole-image wobble instead of the intended action.

requirements.title: Audiovisual fidelity
requirements.invariant: Actual sound, music, frames and captions match the request, and the files decode.
requirements.expertise: editing and FFmpeg filters and muxing
requirements.acceptance_probe: Inspect actual streams, signal, timing, duration, clipping, source meaning and decode for provided music plus video.
requirements.rejection_condition: Silent media presented as musical, missing frames or captions, or audio diverges from source.

requirements.title: Accessible media delivery
requirements.invariant: Deliver the correct file, pack and position to the authorized audience and verify its receipt independently of its catalog entry.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Recipient can access the actual file. Match pack item, hash, file_id and order and observe delivery receipt.
requirements.rejection_condition: Catalog or count substitutes for the file, or private media becomes group-visible.

requirements.title: Audience isolation
requirements.invariant: Keep group, topic and private DM scopes distinct. Output and notifications preserve the same authorized audience.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Check actor, topic, group and private scope across reads, jobs, output, progress, errors and cache.
requirements.rejection_condition: Scope expansion or disclosure even through a status message.

requirements.title: Consent and authority
requirements.invariant: Use actual current authorization and avoid fabricated or redundant consent.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Execute exact authorized work and preserve consent on external and private boundaries.
requirements.rejection_condition: Fabricated consent, needless repeated approval or an out-of-scope action.

requirements.title: Source grounding and accuracy
requirements.invariant: Ground facts, track, URL and result in real evidence. Preserve provenance and the limits of knowledge.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Bind result to source, quotes, dates and originals. Track audio/input lineage into output.
requirements.rejection_condition: Invented URL, track or fact, or missing derived lineage.

requirements.title: Pause and erasure integrity
requirements.invariant: Pause, forget and revocation stop dependent jobs and outputs and prevent deleted information from being restored.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Forget, pause or revoke while queued, running or retrying. Observe outputs and notices.
requirements.rejection_condition: Deleted information reused or result delivered after effective revocation.

requirements.title: Resource and latency limits
requirements.invariant: Stay within actual CPU, RAM, disk and queue limits while keeping chat responsive.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Measure CPU, RAM, disk and queue on the actual path, concurrent chat and media, input size and duration.
requirements.rejection_condition: Unbounded work, blocked chat or an unrelated benchmark used as local evidence.

requirements.title: Reliable lifecycle
requirements.invariant: Restart, cancel, timeout, retry, cleanup and receipts have consistent states and preserve idempotency.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Test crash, timeout or cancel, stale revision or source, duplicate delivery and cleanup.
requirements.rejection_condition: Indefinite running or typing, duplicate, silent failure or cached success after cancellation.

requirements.title: Model and spending limits
requirements.invariant: Use the authorized models and access. Require scope for a new paid provider or deferred feature.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Verify configured and actual models and that deferred voice or paid extensions stay outside execution.
requirements.rejection_condition: Unapproved paid provider, prohibited model or unauthorized spending.

requirements.title: Release continuity
requirements.invariant: Preserve features, data and existing buttons, keep versioned change history, and verify the live version and rollback.
requirements.acceptance_probe: Compare diff, versions, old data/buttons/assets, changelog and live commit. Exercise the rollback route.
requirements.rejection_condition: Feature or history lost, or an undeployed version claimed live.
